correctness.rationale: The Cayley identity C=2G-I plus strict positivity of the tridiagonal M-matrix inverse reduces the sign test to the central return diagonal. Formula (1) for the full Green kernel satisfies the exact Neumann recurrence, endpoint reflection identities and source jump. The diagonal geometric sum is smallest at the central vertex/pair, and the Laplacian spectral decomposition makes every diagonal strictly decreasing from 1 to 1/n. This proves unique threshold roots for n>=3 and unconditional n=2. Exact ratios for consecutive central diagonals establish decreasing thresholds and the limiting s=3/4. Expanding the odd and even root equations gives 4*3^{-n} and (20/3)*3^{-n} with O(n*9^{-n}) errors. A standalone standard-library verifier reproduced 105 complete rational matrix kernel identities and supplementary root checks; no infinite inference rests on enumeration.

value.rationale: The all-size nonnegative end-step cutoff for a standard reflecting/no-flux path heat semidiscretization is a direct physical invariant, not an arbitrary numerical slice. The exact central criterion, strictly decreasing finite-mesh thresholds, sharp all-mesh CFL of 3/2, and parity-dependent exponentially small finite corrections quantify when a stable second-order heat step can create negative concentrations. The contrast with known Dirichlet behavior identifies meaningful boundary dependence. This gives an exact reproducible positivity benchmark for finite-volume diffusion codes and does not claim broader PDE convergence.
